value.rationale: The first positive orbit eigenvalue is an intrinsic stationary-selection relaxation rate of the source physical model, not an arbitrary statistic. Opposite parameter monotonicities and an explicit singular Hardy edge distinguish two natural dynamical clocks as the drive approaches its phase boundary. The 1/16 endpoint is sharp, not a fixed-case numerical increment, and requires genuinely singular variational analysis. Its scope does not overclaim uniform full-Liouvillian dynamics.
